# FieldSimR

**FieldSimR** is an R package for simulating plot data in
multi-environment field trials with one or more traits. Its core
function generates plot errors that capture:

- **spatial trend**,
- **random error (noise)**, and
- **extraneous variation**.

Spatial trend is simulated using bivariate interpolation or a separable
first order autoregressive (AR1) process. Random error is simulated
using an independent process. Extraneous variation is simulated using
random or zig-zag ordering between neighbouring columns and/or rows. The
three error components are combined at a user-defined ratio.

Phenotypes can be generated by combining the plot errors with genetic
values (e.g., true, simulated, or predicted). **FieldSimR** provides
wrapper functions to simulate correlated genetic values that capture
genotype-by-environment (GxE) interaction with the R package
[AlphaSimR](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=AlphaSimR).

  

### Installation

[FieldSimR](https://cran.r-project.org/package=FieldSimR) is available
on CRAN.

To install use:

    install.packages("FieldSimR")

  

### Vignettes

- [Simulation of genetic values based on a compound symmetry model for
  GxE
  interaction](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/articles/compound_symmetry_GxE_demo.html)
- [Simulation of genetic values based on an unstructured model for GxE
  interaction](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/articles/unstructured_GxE_demo.html)
- [Simulation of plot errors and phenotypes in a plant breeding field
  trial](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/articles/spatial_variation_demo.html)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`compsym_asr_input()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/compsym_asr_input.md)
  : Simulate genetic values based on a compound symmetry model for GxE
  interaction - \`AlphaSimR\` input parameters
- [`compsym_asr_output()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/compsym_asr_output.md)
  : Simulate genetic values based on a compound symmetry model for GxE
  interaction - Simulation with \`AlphaSimR\`
- [`error_df_bivar`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/error_df_bivar.md)
  : Plot errors - Example data frame
- [`field_trial_error()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/field_trial_error.md)
  : Simulate plot errors in plant breeding field trials
- [`group_cor_mat()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/group_cor_mat.md)
  : Simulate a reduced rank correlation matrix with multiple groups
- [`gv_df_unstr`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/gv_df_unstr.md)
  : Genetic values - Example data frame
- [`make_phenotypes()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/make_phenotypes.md)
  : Generate phenotypes - Combine genetic values and plot errors
- [`measure_variances()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/measure_variances.md)
  : Measure variances from a covariance matrix
- [`multi_asr_input()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/multi_asr_input.md)
  : Simulate genetic values based on a multiplicative model for GxE
  interaction - \`AlphaSimR\` input parameters
- [`multi_asr_output()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/multi_asr_output.md)
  : Simulate genetic values based on a multiplicative model for GxE
  interaction - Simulation with \`AlphaSimR\`
- [`plot_effects()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/plot_effects.md)
  : Graphics for plot effects
- [`plot_hist()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/plot_hist.md)
  : Histogram of effects.
- [`plot_matrix()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/plot_matrix.md)
  : Graphics for matrices
- [`qq_plot()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/qq_plot.md)
  : Q-Q plot
- [`rand_cor_mat()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/rand_cor_mat.md)
  : Simulate a random correlation matrix
- [`rand_diag_mat()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/rand_diag_mat.md)
  : Simulate a random diagonal variance matrix
- [`sample_met()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/sample_met.md)
  : Sample environments from a target population
- [`sample_variogram()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/sample_variogram.md)
  : Sample variogram
- [`skew_diag_mat()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/skew_diag_mat.md)
  : Simulate a skewed diagonal variance matrix
- [`struc_cor_mat()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/struc_cor_mat.md)
  : Simulate a structured correlation matrix with reduced rank
- [`theoretical_variogram()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/theoretical_variogram.md)
  : Theoretical variogram
- [`unstr_asr_input()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/unstr_asr_input.md)
  : Simulate genetic values based on an unstructured model for GxE
  interaction - \`AlphaSimR\` input parameters
- [`unstr_asr_output()`](https://crwerner.github.io/fieldsimr/reference/unstr_asr_output.md)
  : Simulate genetic values based on an unstructured model for GxE
  interaction - Simulation with \`AlphaSimR\`
